passage.label: Al-Baqarah — Allah gives hikmah to whom He wills; only ulu al-albab remember; whatever spent or vowed Allah knows it; wrongdoers have no helpers; public vs private charity both valid; riba consumers stand like one touched by shaytan; they say trade is like riba but Allah permitted trade and forbade riba; admonition recipient who stops keeps past gains; war from Allah and Messenger for persisting; debtor in difficulty: grant respite or forgive as charity; fear Day of return to Allah

arabicExcerpts.text: يُؤۡتِي ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَن يُؤۡتَ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ فَقَدۡ أُوتِيَ خَيۡرٗا كَثِيرٗاۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
وَمَآ أَنفَقۡتُم مِّن نَّفَقَةٍ أَوۡ نَذَرۡتُم مِّن نَّذۡرٖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُهُۥۗ وَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ أَنصَارٍ
إِن تُبۡدُواْ ٱلصَّدَقَٰتِ فَنِعِمَّا هِيَۖ وَإِن تُخۡفُوهَا وَتُؤۡتُوهَا ٱلۡفُقَرَآءَ فَهُوَ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡۚ وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنكُم مِّن سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ

۞لَّيۡسَ عَلَيۡكَ هُدَىٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۗ وَمَا تُنفِقُواْ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ فَلِأَنفُسِكُمۡۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُونَ إِلَّا ٱبۡتِغَآءَ وَجۡهِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُواْ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ يُوَفَّ إِلَيۡكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تُظۡلَمُونَ

لِلۡفُقَرَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُحۡصِرُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ ضَرۡبٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَحۡسَبُهُمُ ٱلۡجَاهِلُ أَغۡنِيَآءَ مِنَ ٱلتَّعَفُّفِ تَعۡرِفُهُم بِسِيمَٰهُمۡ لَا يَسۡـَٔلُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ إِلۡحَافٗاۗ وَمَا تُنفِقُواْ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٌ
ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمۡوَٰلَهُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ سِرّٗا وَعَلَانِيَةٗ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ

ٱلَّذِينَ يَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلرِّبَوٰاْ لَا يَقُومُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَقُومُ ٱلَّذِي يَتَخَبَّطُهُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ مِنَ ٱلۡمَسِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡبَيۡعُ مِثۡلُ ٱلرِّبَوٰاْۗ وَأَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡبَيۡعَ وَحَرَّمَ ٱلرِّبَوٰاْۚ فَمَن جَآءَهُۥ مَوۡعِظَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ فَٱنتَهَىٰ فَلَهُۥ مَا سَلَفَ وَأَمۡرُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ وَمَنۡ عَادَ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
يَمۡحَقُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّبَوٰاْ وَيُرۡبِي ٱلصَّدَقَٰتِۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ أَثِيمٍ

mainSubject.label: Divine wisdom (hikmah) granted selectively to those of understanding; accountability for all spending and vows; public and private charity both rewarded; riba prohibition with explicit distinction from permitted trade; graduated response: admonition allows keeping past gains, persistence triggers divine-messenger war declaration; debtor relief through respite or forgiveness as superior charity; eschatological accountability reminder

subordinateSubjects.label: Hikmah granted to whom Allah wills; ulu al-albab remember
All spending and vows known to Allah; wrongdoers have no helpers
Public charity good; private charity better and expiates sins
Guidance not incumbent on Prophet; Allah guides whom He wills
Whatever good spent benefits self; Allah knows it
Poor absorbed in Allah's way unable to travel; recognized by mark not begging importunately
Those who consume riba stand like one touched by shaytan's stroke
Trade permitted, riba forbidden: explicit divine distinction
Admonition recipient who stops: past gains retained
War from Allah and His Messenger for persistent riba
Debtor in difficulty: respite until ease; forgiveness better
Fear Day of return to Allah; full recompense without injustice

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Command: fear a Day when you will be returned to Allah; every soul will be fully compensated.

notes: Pass A pilot 12, passage 40/6. Core riba legislation block. Contains the strongest anti-riba language in Quran (war from Allah and Messenger). Hikmah concept (2:269) connects to wisdom tradition. Debtor relief (2:276) anticipates modern bankruptcy concepts. Links to interest-free-finance, contracts-commerce.
